prompt: Diels-Alder: (E)-1,3-pentadiene + methyl acrylate (CH₂=CH-COOMe), heat. Draw the major cycloadduct (ortho rule).
explanation: For 1-substituted diene + mono-substituted dienophile, the major product is the ortho isomer (the two substituents end up 1,2 on the new ring). This arises from orbital coefficient matching in the HOMO-LUMO interaction.
